One static binary. It keeps its state in SQLite by default (no separate database to run) or in PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB or SQL Server if you would rather. No agent on your GitLab, no plugin, no patched instance.

Work through [GitLab-side setup]({{< relref "/docs/gitlab-setup" >}}) first, whichever target you pick.

{{< cards >}}
  {{< card link="kubernetes" title="Kubernetes" subtitle="Helm chart with probes, ingress, secrets and an optional backfill Job." >}}
  {{< card link="docker-compose" title="Docker Compose" subtitle="The app and a PostgreSQL on one host, from one file." >}}
  {{< card link="bare-binary" title="Bare binary" subtitle="A systemd unit against a database you already run." >}}
  {{< card link="helm-values" title="Helm chart values" subtitle="Every value of the chart, generated from values.yaml." >}}
{{< /cards >}}

{{< callout type="warning" >}}
Run one copy of it. It owns your instance's webhooks and its own background sweeps, so a second replica just does everything twice.
{{< /callout >}}
